name: Nathanos Blightcaller
summary: Nathanos Blightcaller, once Nathanos Marris, stands at his ruined homestead in the Eastern Plaguelands as the deadly champion of Queen Sylvanas Windrunner. In life he was the first and only human Ranger Lord of Quel'Thalas, and in undeath he trains Forsaken hunters while guarding the eastern frontier with biting contempt for all who approach.

sections.title: The Only Human Farstrider
sections.body: Before the Third War, Nathanos Marris was an extraordinary marksman and tactical genius hailing from the rural outskirts of Lordaeron. His battlefield exploits against the Amani trolls caught the attention of Sylvanas Windrunner, the Ranger-General of Silvermoon. Defying the staunch prejudices of elven nobility—including protests from Prince Kael'thas Sunstrider—Sylvanas elevated him into the Farstriders. Nathanos became the only human to ever attain the prestigious rank of Ranger Lord. Weary of elven court politics and cold sneers from peers like Lor'themar Theron, he spent his downtime at his family estate, the Marris Stead, where Sylvanas frequently visited him.

sections.title: The Fall and Rebirth
sections.body: When Prince Arthas and the Scourge swept through Lordaeron following the purge of Stratholme, the plague consumed the kingdom. Nathanos made a desperate stand at his estate, but fell to the monstrous abomination Ramstein the Gorger. Raised as a mindless undead thrall, he roamed the blighted fields killing in the Lich King's name. After Sylvanas shattered the Scourge's mental grip and established the Forsaken in the Undercity, she tracked him down. Her dark rangers subdued the rabid ghoul, and Sylvanas personally tore his consciousness free from the Lich King's will, returning his tactical brilliance and fiery loyalty to her side.

sections.title: Champion of the Banshee Queen
sections.body: Adopting the epithet Blightcaller, Nathanos took up permanent residence at the decrepit Marris Stead. He serves as Sylvanas's champion, hunter trainer, and regional spymaster in the contested Eastern Plaguelands, protected by foul plaguehounds. Alliance intelligence has identified his survival with deep alarm; Highlord Bolvar Fordragon views a master tactician of Nathanos's caliber leading undead forces as an intolerable threat to human survival, dispatching strike forces to assassinate the fallen Ranger Lord.

aliases: who is the guy at marris stead
faq.answer: Nathanos Blightcaller was Nathanos Marris, a renowned human marksman and the only non-elf ever appointed Ranger Lord of Quel'Thalas by Sylvanas Windrunner. Following his death and resurrection during the Third War, Sylvanas freed his mind from the Scourge. He now serves as her champion and hunter trainer at his ancestral home in the Eastern Plaguelands.

faq.q: Why is Nathanos at the Marris Stead?
faq.answer: The Marris Stead was Nathanos's childhood home in life. He preferred its quiet isolation to the snobbish politics of Silvermoon City. In undeath, he chose to return to his ruined estate, transforming it into an outpost to train Forsaken hunters and monitor Alliance and Scourge movements.

faq.q: How did Nathanos become an undead?
faq.answer: Nathanos was killed at his homestead during the Third War by the Scourge abomination Ramstein the Gorger. He rose as an obedient, mindless thrall to the Lich King until Sylvanas tracked him down, subdued him, and liberated his mind so he could join the Forsaken.

faq.q: Why does the Alliance want to kill him?
faq.answer: Alliance leadership in Stormwind discovered that Nathanos Marris—one of the Alliance's greatest military minds and tactical geniuses—did not perish permanently, but instead joined the Forsaken. Viewing his tactical brilliance as an immense danger, Highlord Bolvar Fordragon orders his elimination.

faq.q: What is his relationship with Sylvanas?
faq.answer: Nathanos was Sylvanas's prize pupil, trusted confidant, and champion. Sylvanas defied high elven tradition and her own prince to grant him the title of Ranger Lord, sparking widespread rumors of a romantic bond. In undeath, his loyalty to the Banshee Queen remains absolute and unwavering.

faq.q: Who are the hounds standing near him?
faq.answer: They are vicious plaguehounds that Nathanos trained himself. Kept at his side to guard the ruins of the Marris Stead, they attack any intruders foolish enough to trespass on his territory.

angles.text: Nathanos is the highest-ranking hunter trainer for the Forsaken, bringing the rigorous, legendary Farstrider marksmanship techniques of Quel'Thalas to the undead of Lordaeron.
As the champion of the Dark Lady, Nathanos embodies the bitter resilience of the Forsaken, though he has little patience for incompetence among his peers.
Seeing a decorated hero of Lordaeron and a celebrated Farstrider fighting beneath the banner of the Forsaken is a stinging insult and a lethal tactical problem for Stormwind.
Nathanos provides critical tactical guidance and hunter training for the Horde in the Plaguelands, though he treats visitors with caustic disdain.
